preconditions.description: The number of necklace parts n is between 1 and 500,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a < 2**20 and 0 <= b < 2**20 for a, b in necklace_parts)
preconditions.description: Each pearl color a and b in the necklace parts is a non-negative integer less than 2^20.

postconditions.expression: b == max(min(k for u, v in necklace_parts for k in range(21) if (u ^ v) % (2**(k+1)) != 0 or u == v), default=20)
postconditions.description: The output beauty b is the maximum possible beauty of a necklace built from all given parts.

postconditions.expression: len(p) == 2 * n and len(set(p)) == 2 * n and all(1 <= x <= 2 * n for x in p)
postconditions.description: The output permutation p contains exactly 2n distinct integers, each between 1 and 2n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(abs(p.index(2*i-1) - p.index(2*i)) == 1 or abs(p.index(2*i-1) - p.index(2*i)) == 2*n-1 for i in range(1, n+1))
postconditions.description: Indices of pearls belonging to the same necklace part appear at neighboring positions in the permutation p.
